minor_issues.issue: 化合物 13 描述为「开环产物」(13 则来自初始 1,14-环化后立即终止环化所对应的开环产物) 不准确
minor_issues.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 4 页正文「13 is formed after the initial 1,14-cyclization step」与 Figure 4 中 13 的结构图
minor_issues.correction: 应改为「经初始 1,14-环化形成 14 元大环后即终止后续环化的产物」或「仅经历初始环化步骤的单环/双环产物」。原文 Fig 4 显示 13 至少含一个环（系 1,14-环化产物），并非开链结构。

verified_claims.claim: GTC2 (A0A848GTC2) 来源于 C. fulva，与 chryseodiene synthase 序列一致性 42%；E2E2 (A0A1N6E2E2) 来源于 C. niabensis，与已知 TPSs 一致性低于 30%
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 2 页第 2.1 节
verified_claims.evidence: We previously collected 85 characterized terpene synthases (TPSs) and 48 TPSs from 14 in-house sequenced Streptomyces islates [6]... E2E2 shares less than 30% amino acid identity with the collected TPSs, whereas GTC2 shows 42% identity with chryseodiene synthase.

verified_claims.claim: GTC2 利用 FPP 和 GGPP，分离得到 8 个化合物 1–8；化合物 8 为新化合物，分子式 C20H34O，HRMS [M]+• m/z 290.2589（计算值 290.2605）
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 2 页第 2.2 节
verified_claims.evidence: Enzymatic assays using GPP, FPP, GGPP, and GFPP as substrates revealed that GTC2 could utilize both FPP and GGPP... eight compounds (1–8) were isolated. Compound 8 was identified as a new structure. HRMS analysis revealed a molecular formula of C20H34O ([M]+⋅ m/z 290.2589; calcd 290.2605)

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 8 仅在体内异源表达体系中出现，体外酶活和对照实验中均未检出
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 2 页正文
verified_claims.evidence: Product 8 was observed only in the in vivo system; it was absent in both the in vitro assay and the control experiment (Fig. 1A).

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 9 为新二萜，分子式 C20H34O，HRMS [M]+• 实测 290.2588（计算值 290.2605）；DP4+ 分析 B1 异构体匹配概率 100%，相对构型指认为 3S*,14S*
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 3 页第 2.3 节
verified_claims.evidence: Compound 9 represented a new diterpene structure... molecular formula (C20H34O) determined by HRMS ([M]+⋅ calcd 290.2605, found 290.2588)... Based on the DP4+ statistical analysis, isomer B1 exhibited a 100% probability of matching the experimental NMR data (Fig. S34), allowing the relative configuration of compound 9 to be assigned as 3S*,14S*.

verified_claims.claim: E2E2 Y293N 变体几乎完全改变产物谱，分离得到 11、12、13 三个已知二萜；化合物 11 经单晶 X 射线衍射确证
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 4 页第 2.4 节与第 3 节
verified_claims.evidence: E2E2 Y293 was co-expressed with a GGPP synthase in an E. coli chassis, affording the production of compounds 11, 12, and 13 (Fig. 4, Fig. S37–S42), all of which have been previously reported... one of which (11) was confirmed by single-crystal X-ray diffraction.

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 11 由 A2 被水捕获产生；12 由 A2 去质子产生；13 经初始 1,14-环化后形成
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 4 页第 2.4 节
verified_claims.evidence: 11 arises from quenching of cation A2 by water, whereas 12 is generated via deprotonation of A2. 13 is formed after the initial 1,14-cyclization step.

verified_claims.claim: E2E2 蛋白浓度 4.52 mg/mL，GTC2 蛋白浓度 3.18 mg/mL
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 5 页第 4.2 节
verified_claims.evidence: The concentrations of purified E2E2 and GTC2 proteins were 4.52 mg mL−1 and 3.18 mg mL−1, respectively.

verified_claims.claim: 定点突变筛选中 L212A、L212F、M179A、M179F 完全失活；M179L、V176L、F77L 仅微弱活性；V176F 与野生型产物谱几乎相同；Y293L 和 Y293F 产物谱明显改变
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文 PDF 第 4 页第 2.4 节
verified_claims.evidence: The results showed that variants L212A, L212F, M179A, and M179F lost enzymatic activity, whereas M179L, V176L and F77L exhibited only weak activity. Mutant V176F produced nearly identical product profile to the wild-type enzyme, while Y293L and Y293F generated distinct product profile (Fig. S35).
